759480102.text: Sure. I'm still a competitive wrestler, after all.

759480103.text: I'm mostly tied up with logistics, but come the weekend, I can wrestle to my heart's content.

759480104.text: Here at the Collective of Plenty, being the most agriculturally developed tribe in Natlan as we are, we naturally prioritize resource coordination and management above all else.

759480105.text: My job is to ensure that everyone can eat as much as they want while ensuring that there's no waste.

759480106.text: #But that's enough of my blabbing — it's time for you to grab a bite to eat! I can see you're still a growing {M#lad}{F#lass}, so you mustn't let yourself go hungry!
